selection_contract.inclusion_rule: Include the complete staged methodological architecture and no substantive case proposition.
selection_contract.exclusion_rule: Exclude canonical case assertions and private manuscript prose from this architecture-only exhibit.
selection_contract.ordering_rule: Render the declared route, jurisdiction, object, and report-contract order deterministically.
selection_contract.truncation_rule: Do not truncate the declared methodological architecture.
selection_contract.missingness_statement: No substantive candidate evidence universe is asserted by this architecture-only projection.
selection_contract.compression_disclosure: This release compresses repository methodology into a review aperture; it does not compress or adjudicate a substantive case universe.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic methodological and publication-architecture projection joining POOF jurisdictions to Clifford evidence and referral law.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A substantive case finding, approved public edition, deployed service, independent review, or canonical evidence source.
